title: ‘The Super Mario Galaxy Movie’ Is Here – Celebrate the Release With This Mario-Themed Merch
summary: Our picks include console cases, talking flowers and power-up-themed desk lamps.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

The Super Mario Galaxy Movie is finally here, serving as a sequel to the successful The Super Mario Bros. Movie from 2023.

This film takes inspo from Nintendo’s Super Mario Galaxy game down to the title and features beloved plumber Mario, voiced by Chris Pratt, and his mustachioed brother Luigi, voiced by Charlie Day, along with the ruler of the Mushroom Kingdom, Princess Peach, voiced by Anya Taylor-Joy. New characters only seen in the game are also featured in the new iteration, including Princess Rosalina, played by Brie Larson and Bowser Jr. by Benny Safdie.

Hardcore Mario fans are already sweeping up tickets for the sequel in hordes. While we can’t exactly time travel to see how this sequel goes, we can rely on data from the first film. According to Variety , the film made $1.3 billion at the worldwide box office, surpassing giant films like Frozen . The film became the highest-grossing film based on a video game and one of the highest-grossing animated movies of all time.

The music from the OG film was also a hit with audiences. “Peaches” recorded for The Super Mario Bros. Movie by Jack Black peaked on the Billboard Hot 100 at No. 56 in April 2023. While the track wasn’t featured in the OG games, it proves just how popular and impactful Mario -related content, music or otherwise, can be even after 40 years.

In celebration of the new flick and all things Mario, ShopBillboard is sharing our favorite Mario-themed merch available online, including Switch and Switch 2 accessories, home decor, apparel and more. We’ve spotlighted things like talking flowers, neon Yoshi signs, cute console cases and Luma bath bombs that all encapsulate the effervescent spirit of the ever-popular franchise. Shop our picks below.

For on-the-go usage, this case is also equipped with a high-capacity charging cable so you can power up your console even if you don’t have access to an outlet.

Yellow Luma Bath Bomb

$13

Buy Now at Lush

This Lush bath bomb is shaped like a yellow Luma seen in the Nintendo game Super Mario Galaxy . This bath bomb makes the water glittery and is scented like peach.

Lush didn’t come to play when it came to Mario Day. The brand dropped a bunch of inventive Mario-themed bath and body products (including its iconic bath bombs) that you can buy now on the brand’s website. Some of our favorites include the Yellow Luma bath bomb , retailing for $13. The star-shaped bath bomb is scented like peach and turns the water into a fizzy, glittering wonderland. Luma is a companion character featured in games such as Nintendo’s Super Mario Galaxy .

Mario Kart™ – Mario & Standard Kart

$169.99

Buy Now at Lego

This is a Mario Lego set inspired by the Nintendo game Mario Kart . The detailed set sees Mario seated in his race car.

Mario Kart was a huge part of many kids’ gaming experience growing up. Lego has translated the magic of the beloved game into a multitude of sets that you can buy now. Our favorite is the Mario set for $169.99 of the plumber sitting in his kart mid-race.

Super Mario Kids Interactive Smartwatch with Camera

$29.99

Buy Now On Amazon

This is a Super Mario-inspired smart watch made for kids. The interactive watch features 10 digital clock/watch faces and 3 wallpapers featuring Mario characters that kids can switch out and accessorize with.

While Apple watches aren’t really made for kids, the next best thing, and a cooler version in our opinion, is this Super Mario Smart Watch for $29.99 . The affordable accessories feature 10 digital clock/watch faces and three wallpapers featuring all your favorite Mario characters from the mustachioed plumber to his sidekick Yoshi. These alternative faces and wallpapers allow your child to customize their watch to their liking. As far as features go, this watch does it all. You’ve got a camera, video capabilities, a voice recorder, a calculator, an alarm, a timer, a stopwatch and a calendar.

Paladone Super Mario Icon Desk Light

$28.32

Level up your home decor with this desk light inspired by power-ups from Mario. You’ve got a mushroom, super star and a fire flower. 

Looking to level up your home decor game? Amazon features a Super Mario desk lamp that is a gamer-friendly way to liven up any space. The lamp features power-up motifs, including a mushroom that helps Mario grow, a super star that makes him invincible and a fire flower that allows the character to throw fireballs.

Mattel Games UNO Super Mario Card Game

$11.87

This Uno Game from Mattel is Mario-themed and an Amazon exclusive. It’s the game of Uno we all know and love, except the cards feature iconic Mario characters.

This board game is like if Uno and Mario had a baby. The family fun game is the Uno you know and love, except the cards feature some of the Mario franchise’s most iconic characters like Mario and Luigi, along with Toad and Princess Peach. The themed card pack comes in a collector’s tin with Princess Peach’s castle in the background.

The stylish merch comes in cream and red with retro Mario graphics and motifs from the game on the front and back. This tee is meant to look like a ringer tee with the contrasting trim throughout.

Super Mario Bros. Princess Rosalina Pajama Pants

$26.90

Buy Now at Hot Topic

Cozy up with these Princess Rosalina pj bottoms. The style features an adjustable drawstring closure and a Rosalina print.

Cozy up in these Princess Rosalina PJs available for $26.90 at Hot Topic. The bottoms are a galactic purple and feature a Rosalina print, a character from Super Mario Galaxy , alongside her star Luma companion. These PJs feature pockets and an elasticized waist for comfort. A drawstring closure allows wearers to adjust the fit.

TOMY Pop Up Super Mario Game

$17.99

Tomy presents a Super Mario game you won’t want to put down. The goal is to put character coins in the slots without making Mario pop out of the warp pipe.

Another Mario-themed board game, this time from Tomy. This Pop-Up Super Mario Game retails for $17.99 and works similarly to board games like Pop-Up Pirate, where players need to stick coins into slots around the warp pipe carefully so they don’t trigger Mario, who is hiding inside the pipe, waiting to pop up.
